Sumedha Fiscal Services Ltd ("Manager to the Open Offer") has informed BSE as under :

"With respect to the captioned subject, we Sumedha Fiscal Services Limited, in the capacity of Manager to the Offer ("Manager") in respect of the Open Offer announced by Gunny Dealers Limited ("Acquirer 1") and G Jerambhai Exports Limited ("Acquirer 2"), collectively referred to as the "Acquirers", for the acquisition of up to 79,95,997 Equity Shares, representing 26% of the Equity Share Capital and 24.64% of Equity and Preference Voting Share Capital of AI Champdany Industries Limited ("Target Company"), from its Public Shareholders, pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 3(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 ("SEBI (SAST) Regulations"), hereby inform that G Jerambhai Exports Limited (Acquirer 2) has acquired 40,53,751 equity shares as against the agreed 40,74,129 equity shares from Jayshree Wadhwa at a market price of ? 27.14 (Twenty Seven and Fourteen Paise) (excluding transaction costs) on November 23, 2026, through on market acquisition, in accordance with the terms of the Share Purchase Agreement dated November 02, 2026. The difference of quantity i.e, 20,378 equity shares were acquired by some other buyer in the open market and could not be acquired by G Jerambhai Exports Limited.

Since the acquisition of SPA shares was acquired at a price less than the open Offer price of ? 29.50/- (Rupees Twenty Nine and Fifty Paise Only), the Acquirers are not required to revise the Open Offer Price, that will be offered to the Public Shareholders who validly tender their Offer Shares.

The Open Offer is triggered in compliance with the provisions of Regulations 3(2) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, pursuant to the execution of the Share Purchase Agreement dated November 2, 2026, inter-alia, by and amongst Ms. Jayshree Wadhwa, a Citizen of the United Kingdom, resident of India within the provisions of the Income Tax Act (hereinafter referred to as "Seller") and G Jerambhai Exports Limited (Acquirer 2) for the acquisition of 40,74,129 (Forty Lakhs Seventy Four Thousand One Hundred and Twenty Nine) Equity Shares, representing 13.25% of Equity share capital and 9.44% of the equity and preference voting share capital of the Target Company."

Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, please find enclosed herewith a disclosure received from Mrs. Chandrika Rajnikant Shah, Member of the Promoter Group of the Company.
